## 7. In-circuit verification and N = 1,500 (E2: 7,680 core-seconds, eight 16-core hosts, 60 s)

Method (E). System A: the measured 4,120 core-seconds at category 1 times the per-child factor f = s x (q_x / q_1) x h + (1 - s) x a, where s is the query-proportional share of a verified child (Keccak-f x measured cycles per modelled Keccak-f, revision5.cycles_per_keccak), h the Keccak-f per opened position relative to category 1, a the field-arithmetic factor. Proving time follows committed words (recursion.md 9.10 reading 2), so the total scales by f within the step function of the padded stack. System B: the category 1 slot (6.5 M AND rows with SHA-256) times the query ratio and the hash factor of the admissible hash, padded to the next power of two, at the measured core-seconds a padded slot.

System A: cycles per modelled Keccak-f of a child 19.8; query-proportional share s = 0.80 (E).

| Target | Field | q ratio (node level 0) | h | a | f | A core-seconds (E) | A hosts for 60 s |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cat1 | 2^256 | 1.00 | 1.0 | 1.0 | 1.00 | 4,120 | 4.3 |
| cat3 | 2^256 | 1.42 | 1.0 | 1.0 | 1.34 | 5,511 | 5.7 |
| cat3 | 2^384 | 1.42 | 1.25 | 2.25 | 1.87 | 7,710 | 8.0 |
| cat5 | 2^384 | 1.84 | 1.25 | 2.25 | 2.29 | 9,436 | 9.8 |
| cat5 | 2^512 | 1.84 | 1.5 | 3.0 | 2.81 | 11,570 | 12.1 |

System B, certified unique-decoding rows (h: in-circuit AND rows a Merkle opening against SHA-256 at category 1; SHA-384 / SHA-512 compression estimated at 455 AND rows (80 rounds of 64-bit words against SHA-256's 364 C for 64), one compression a 96- or 128-byte node in compression-function mode, leaves in 128-byte blocks; SHAKE256 at 600 AND rows a Keccak-f (C by structure), one permutation a 96-byte node, two a 128-byte node with a tag byte beyond 135 bytes). 'Being counted': the system B builder is counting these rows.

## 8. Transfers a block (E)

Per bundled transfer: 200 block bytes (a transfer record without value balance or on-chain package, specification 15.1; the tree encoding of 15.2 and the anchor table are left out, so capacities are upper figures). Bundles may use W - LEAF_RESERVE = 2,850,000 weight and 1,982,544 bytes (W5); one tree, one root proof a system. Capacity = min(bytes, (2,850,000 - root proofs) / bytes a transfer, 16,384).

| Profile | Root proof A (B) | Root proof B (B) | Both within PROOF_BYTES_MAX (W1) | Transfers by weight | By bytes | Capacity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| cat1, nodes at 1/2 and 1/8 (as built) | 875,309 | 735,410 | yes | 6,196 | 9,913 | 6,196 |
| cat3, nodes at 1/2 and 1/8 | 1,458,510 | 1,211,351 | yes | 901 | 9,913 | 901 |
| cat3, nodes at 1/4 and 1/16 | 1,277,031 | 1,179,410 | yes | 1,968 | 9,913 | 1,968 |
| cat5, A 2^384 node at 1/4, B 2^512 node at 1/16 | 2,151,812 | 2,447,275 | **no** | 0 | 9,913 | 0 |
